name: UnderShot: An Undertale X Oneshot Mod
storyline:
After the events of Oneshot's Solstice run, Niko looks forward to hugging their mama again, and getting pancakes(and maybe also expects a scolding for being gone for so long). They say their goodbyes to the player in an emotional moment, and pass through the portal back home, expecting to be back at the wheat fields soon...

...and then they find themselves falling down a several hundred feet deep crater elsewhere in player's machine. Boy, this was just not their day...
summary: A mod which completely erases Frisk and switches them out with Niko. Takes place right after the solstice run of Oneshot.
